scope: Proposition 7.7 of the manuscript “Uniformization of complete Kähler manifolds with positive bisectional curvature” (preprints/Uniformization-of-complete-Kahler-manifolds-with-positive-bisectional-curvature-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 338 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2960f958368ee0ab), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 59. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every sufficiently large volume clock s, there is a holomorphic local biholo- morphism Φs : Bℂn (r0) → M centered at o, with unitary center derivative for the metric at clock s, and C−1 geucl ≤ Φ∗ sht(s) ≤ Cgeucl. (7.22) For fixed 0 < r1 < r0, chosen sufficiently small, the transition germs Fs,u = Φ−1 u Φs, u ≥ s, extend to nonsingular holomorphic maps on B(r1) with a common bound. They fix 0, compose as germs, and satisfy ‖F′ s,u(0)‖ ≤ 1, | det F′ s,u(0)| = e−(u−s)/2 , ‖F′ s,u(0)−1 ‖ ≤ e(u−s)/2 . (7.23) There are coherent inverse branches fs on neighborhoods of any fixed compact exhaustion set for all sufficiently large s, satisfying fs(o) = 0 and Φsfs = Id. A constant σ > 0, common to all compact sets, satisfies sup K |fs| ≤ e−σs for every fixed compact K and all sufficiently large s. (7.24) For every fixed jet order d there is Cd such that |JdFs,u| ≤ Cd min{1, eCds−σu } (u ≥ s sufficiently large). (7.25) There are c, γ0 > 0 such that, for each fixed 0 < γ ≤ γ0, one has sup |z|≤e−γs |Fs,u(z)| ≤ e−cγu for every u ≥ s ≥ sγ. (7.26) The constants in the last two estimates are independent of the later endpoint u; the starting threshold in (7.24) may depend on K.
